title: Time hierarchy for positive bounds
statement: Let $f,g:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and suppose $g$ is time constructible and $g(n)>0$ for every $n$. Suppose further that for every $A\in\mathbb{N}$ there is an $N\in\mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n\ge N$, $A(f(n)+n+1)^2\le g(n)$. Then $\mathrm{DTIME}(f)$ is a proper subset of $\mathrm{DTIME}(g)$.
hypotheses_covered: For every $A\in\mathbb{N}$, there is $N\in\mathbb{N}$ such that $A(f(n)+n+1)^2\le g(n)$ for all $n\ge N$
